reader.edition-search: ResolveVisible and CommonProgramReferable read no edition (grep for Edition, CobolVersion, DialectBehavior, IsAvailable in ProgramTable.cs, ProgramNameScope.cs, CallBinder.cs, CallEmitter.cs); the 85 difference arrives only through the RECURSIVE attribute being unavailable.
reader.requirement: At 85 a CALL (literal-1 or identifier-1) naming a program-name that several run-unit programs share resolves by §1985:X.1.3.8.1: a program directly contained in the caller first, then a COMMON program directly contained in a program that contains the caller (unless the caller is within that common program), otherwise the separately compiled program; a non-common program nested elsewhere is never reachable.

edition-consulted.switches: the edition's Annex C spelling of a dynamic identifier-1 name (CallEmitter passes ctx.Data.DialectLevel); identity for every name a 1985 program-name can be (ASCII)
PROGRAM-ID ... RECURSIVE refused at 85 (COBOL0885), so ResolveVisible's rule 2 (self-call) and CommonProgramReferable's recursive bypass are unreachable at 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the three-step mechanism is the same code at every edition; only the 2002+ RECURSIVE attribute (refused at 85) widens the common-program exception later
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_04 covers mechanisms a, b and c by literal-1 one level deep; not covered: identifier-1, a common program in an INDIRECT container, a non-common sibling or grandchild shadowing a separate program, a call from inside the common program itself, and the duplicate-name refusals

probes.expected: P1 reaches its own X (a); P2 by literal and by identifier reaches the separate X, and the separate S rather than its non-common sibling S (c); C1A inside common C1 reaches the separate C1 (b's exception); P4 reaches M's common C1 through an indirect container by literal and identifier (b)

probes.expected: refused at 85: no RECURSIVE attribute in this edition
a program directly contained in the caller is called even when it shares the caller's own name (mechanism a)

reader.notes: g85_f02_04 MATCHes at 85. Resolution is at run time in ProgramTable.ResolveVisible (children, then common programs of each container nearest first, then outermost), with the common-program exception written once in ProgramNameScope. Aside: COBOL2213/COBOL2214 cite §2023 text at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: g4deep: a COMMON C2 directly contained in P3 is reached from P5 (two levels inside P3) by literal and identifier-1 (PIC X(30)), while P2 (a sibling of P3) reaches the separate C2: COMMON C2 IN P3 x2 / SEPARATE C2 x2. g4grand: M calling X where X is COMMON in its child P1 reaches the separate X (rule 2 limits the common program to its container's descendants). g4branch: two X in different branches of one separately compiled M refused COBOL2214 (§1985:X.3.1.3 SR2). The reader's gr4e (nested M inside outer M, accepted) is admitted by the literal text of X.1.3.8.1 and X.3.1.3 SR2 (the outermost program is not 'contained within' itself), so not a refutation. cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.2.4 GR4 the text is in GR4; OK §1985:X.1.3.8.1 the text is in the clause; OK §1985:X.3.1.3 SR2 the text is in SR2.
